# boolbase 1.0.0 notice counterpart

LICENSE is copied verbatim from the official source commit recorded in provenance.json. The integrity-verified npm archive lacks this file. Its index.js and README.md match that commit exactly; package.json differs in its test script. This is content matching, not a publisher build attestation.

The current installed dependency paths are Astro → SVGO → css-select → boolbase and css-select → nth-check → boolbase. These describe build-tool installation, not proof of absence from generated assets. The Dockerfile currently copies built web assets and Go notices, but does not copy this directory. Distribution notice integration, generated-asset attribution, other npm gaps, and the complete license gate remain pending.
